meaning: 时尚公司，服装品牌企业
usageNote: 名词短语！说服装品牌行业就用这个，比'clothing brands'更高级感～

examples.en: Many fashion companies are now switching to sustainable materials.
examples.zh: 许多时尚公司正在转向使用可持续材料。

examples.en: She dreams of working for one of the top fashion companies in Milan.
examples.zh: 她梦想在米兰顶级时尚公司之一工作。
